GUIDE

How to play

CONTROLS

WASD move · mouse aims · LMB weapon attack · RMB Q E R spells or skills · Space Dash (Warrior) / Blink (Mage)

Hold Tab for your build · I inventory · F interact · M map · Esc pause

YOUR GOAL

Survive 30 minutes in the desert. Day turns to night and Blood Moon. Three main bosses arrive along the way, and at 30:00 the Crimson Tyrant comes for you.

LEVELING

Pick up XP crystals to level. Each level offers three cards: new spells, spell behaviors or stat boosts. Use Reroll or Banish charges from Unlocks, or take Heal instead to skip the cards and heal.

RAGE AND ENERGY

The Warrior builds Rage by hitting and being hit, then spends it on skills. The Mage spends Arcane Energy, which refills while you keep moving.

WEAPONS AND FORGE

Weapons drop in the world and stay forever. Equip them in the Inventory. Find the Ember Forge in the desert and press F to upgrade, reforge or salvage them.

MODES

Normal ends with the Tyrant. Endless keeps going and gets harder until you fall. Modified run lets you mix the Quickened, Horde and Glass cannon modifiers.

Wipe your entire account?

This permanently deletes everything: all weapons and the armory, gold, unlocks, runes, upgrades, achievements, spell colours and best runs. You start over like a brand-new player.

There is no undo. Settings (volume, graphics) are kept.
